Oakfield Primary School
Weekly Newsletter — Friday 9 October 2026
Dear Parents and Carers,
We hope everyone has had a good week. Please find below some important dates and reminders for the rest of October and the beginning of November.
Year 4 Trip to the Science Museum
Year 4 will visit the Science Museum on Tuesday 13 October. Children should arrive at school at the usual time of 8:45am and will return by approximately 3:45pm.
Please send children with a packed lunch and a named water bottle.
Parents’ Evening
Our autumn Parents’ Evenings will take place on:

* Wednesday 14 October, 3:30pm–6:30pm
* Thursday 15 October, 4:00pm–7:00pm

Appointments are 10 minutes long. If you have not yet booked a slot, please do so through the parent portal by 12 noon on Monday 12 October.
Individual School Photographs
The school photographer will be visiting on Friday 16 October.
Children should come to school in full uniform. Sibling photographs will be taken before the start of the school day from 8:15am.
Harvest Assembly
Families are warmly invited to our Harvest Assembly on Monday 19 October at 9:15am in the school hall.
Doors will open at 9:00am. We expect the assembly to finish by approximately 10:00am.
Donations for the local food bank can be brought into school any time from Monday 12 October.
Half-Term
School will close for half-term at 3:15pm on Friday 23 October.
There will be no school from Monday 26 October to Friday 30 October.
Children return to school on Monday 2 November at 8:45am.
Year 6 Secondary School Applications
A reminder to Year 6 families that the deadline for secondary school applications is Saturday 31 October.
Applications should be made directly through your local authority website.
Friends of Oakfield Halloween Disco
The Friends of Oakfield will hold a Halloween Disco on Thursday 22 October.
Reception–Year 2: 4:30pm–5:30pm
Years 3–6: 6:00pm–7:15pm
Tickets cost £4 and must be purchased by Tuesday 20 October.
Fancy dress is welcome, but please do not send children in masks or with toy weapons.
Flu Vaccinations
The school nursing team will visit on Wednesday 4 November to provide flu vaccinations.
Consent forms must be completed online by 5:00pm on Wednesday 28 October. Further information was sent by email earlier this week.
Looking Ahead
Our Christmas Fair will take place on Saturday 5 December from 11:00am to 2:00pm. More information will follow after half-term.
Thank you for your continued support.
Kind regards,
Mrs Helen Carter
Headteacher
Oakfield Primary School
